metadata.title: Remove Defective Port Status After Field Correction

blocks.content: This request targets defective port records that must lose the D value in fm_opv after the port issue has been corrected in the source network record.

items: Confirm the defect was already corrected in the field.
Verify the rows in fm_opv using homeId and accessNumber.
Set status to blank for the D entries only.
Add support task logs with the incident number.

blocks.content: SELECT "homeId", "accessNumber", "status" FROM fm_opv WHERE "homeId" IN ('BCK007221188004', 'BCK007221188005') AND "accessNumber" IN (450912300, 450912301);
